}} '''Manda Wan''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Manda Wan}}

== Strength ==
By [[Leane Sharif|Leane Sharif's]] account, Manda did not consider her opinion worth much because of their relative strengths in the [[One Power]].{{ref/book|14|37}} Leane's stength after Healing is only {{opsl|42}}, however, so she need not be anything more than moderately weak for Leane to have to obey her.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Leane Sharif}} Nonetheless, Manda seems to hold a position of command, but looks to [[Raechin Connoral]] for approval. This would place her as likely above average strength, but less than Raechin - at least {{opsl|26}}.

==Activities==
She participates in the [[Last Battle]], where she fights alongside Leane, [[Raechin Connoral]] and the [[Amyrlin Seat]] herself, [[Egwene al'Vere]]. She contemplated pulling back by [[gateway]] to rally, until Leane pointed out the furious Amyrlin Seat, calling her Manda's "rally point".{{ref/book|14|37}}

Her status after the Last Battle is unknown, but presumed alive.

== Trivia ==
* She is named after Amanda Wan, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref>Theoryland Interview Database, Twitter 2013, Q34 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=874]</ref>
